description: Cloud knowledge backup via Supermemory.ai free tier. Store and retrieve insights using /v3/documents and /v3/search endpoints. Includes auto-capture cron for session memory logs.
author: openclaw

tools.name: supermemory_cloud_store
tools.description: Upload a knowledge string to Supermemory cloud. Args: content (required), --tag, --source, --custom-id, --entity-context, --json

tools.name: supermemory_cloud_search
tools.description: Search Supermemory cloud for relevant knowledge. Args: query (required), --tag, --no-tag, --limit, --threshold, --json

tools.name: supermemory_auto_capture
tools.description: Scan recent session memory logs and upload high-value insights to cloud. Args: --days, --dry-run, --force, --verbose

cron.description: Daily at 2:00 AM UTC — auto-capture session insights
